title: 12. A Big House on the Sea
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Hooooonk! A deep, loud sound rolls across the sea. In the harbor floats a white ship as big as a house! Hori's ears perk up. Wow! How can such a big ship float without sinking? Hooooonk! The big ship is leaving!
Mom, where is that big ship going? Can we ride it, too? Hori asks, bouncing while holding Mom's hand. Mom smiles. Shall we go aboard and see for ourselves? Kongi can come, too!
They walk up the long gangway joining the dock to the ship. On board, a captain in a white uniform waves. Welcome! Have you come to learn about ships? Hori's heart goes thump, thump!

The ship's wide, flat floor feels like a yard. This is the deck, where people look out at the sea. Hori holds the railing and sees blue water all around. A yard in the middle of the sea! But why doesn't this big, heavy ship sink? The captain explains, Its hollow spaces hold air, making the ship light enough for its size to float.

When we board a ship, we put this on first. The captain gives them orange life jackets. They help your body float if you fall into the water. Kongi puts one on upside down. Isn't this a nap cushion? Everyone laughs. The captain helps Kongi wear it properly, and Kongi smiles.

They climb to a room on the top level with windows all around. This is the wheelhouse. The captain turns this large wheel to choose the ship's direction. The sea stretches far beyond the windows. Hori's eyes grow round. Hooooonk! The big ship is leaving!

Near the bow, a heavy metal anchor hangs from a thick chain. This is the anchor. When we want to stay in one place, we lower it into the sea. It holds the ship so the current doesn't carry it away. Hori taps it, and a deep clang rings out.

Shall Hori try being the captain? Hori and the captain hold the big wheel together. When they pull a red cord, hooooonk! The ship's horn echoes across the harbor! Hori's tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. I sounded the horn! Hooooonk! The big ship is leaving!

The chain rattles as the anchor rises, and the big ship slowly moves out to sea. On the deck, cool sea wind brushes Hori's cheeks. A long white wake trails behind, and waves roll gently. Hori and Kongi wave toward the dock. Hello, sea!

As they leave the ship, Hori holds Mom's hand and chats. We see the sea from the deck, wear life jackets for safety, steer with the wheel in the wheelhouse, and stop drifting with the anchor! The captain takes us safely across the sea. Hori smiles at the water. Hooooonk! The big ship is leaving!
